label: Another BP-style spill in the Gulf and sabotage of offshore rigs
description: A repeat of the BP oil spill attempted in the Gulf, with the huge platform rigs sabotaged, alongside a call to pray over the gas and oil plants at Tuttle in Oklahoma, the Houston area and Louisiana. The specific and checkable part is a second large offshore spill in the Gulf caused by deliberate sabotage rather than an accident.
aliases: I saw BP oil spill again
trying to sabotage oil rigs in the Gulf

label: Explosive drones landed in baseball stadiums, and the Boston marathon on the 20th
description: Drones used against baseball stadiums, the New York Yankees named, with an explosive device landed by drone and set off inside a stadium, and a call to pray over the marathons in Boston on the 20th. The Boston Marathon falls on the third Monday in April, so the date is fixed rather than revealed, and the drone method is the distinguishing element.
aliases: landed down with some kind of explosive device
pray over the race, the marathons on the 20th in Boston

label: Footage collected to blackmail world leaders
description: Leaders set up and filmed, with the footage then used to blackmail them, said to be much darker than people realise, and applied in particular to the Ukrainian president. Nobody is named beyond him and no mechanism or holder of the footage is given, so what would count as a match is the emergence of such material rather than any specific event.
aliases: they got set up and they actually got footage
they use this stuff to blackmail them
much darker than people ever will realize

label: A tornado sweeps down a New York street and stops at the president's feet
description: A cartoon-like tornado moving down a New York street around the president, blowing his hair, jacket and tie, which comes right up to his feet and stops. Offered as an image of a threat that reaches him and goes no further, which makes it unfalsifiable as stated unless a literal tornado is intended.
aliases: I see a storm that looks like a tornado
it comes right up to his feet and it stops

label: Iraqi corruption cut back by half once Iran's hand is out
description: Great corruption in Iraq remaining but tamed back by fifty per cent, given as a number he says he sees, because Iran's hand is out of the cookie jar and is being cut off, and only for a season. Iraq has ranked near the bottom of published corruption indices for two decades, so a halving would be visible in those scores.
aliases: I see the number 50% tamed back
their hand is no longer in the cookie jar
